avoid_when: The presentation does not need an agenda or table of contents.
The agenda requires detailed descriptions, dates, owners, or more than a short list of sections.
A visual roadmap or process flow is preferred over a simple chapter list.

page_semantics.summary: A spacious agenda slide with a prominent title in a vertical color panel and a concise chapter list on the right.
page_semantics.title: 目录

regions.description: Agenda slide heading placed prominently within the colored left panel.
Short table-of-contents list for major chapters or presentation sections.

selection_hints: Use for an early presentation agenda or table-of-contents page.
Best for introducing approximately three concise chapters or major sections.
Choose when a strong colored title panel and spacious list area fit the presentation's visual identity.
